name: script-automator-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for Script Automator — admin RBAC, bans, report moderation, metrics

scripts.test:functions: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-script-automator "node --test test/functions.test.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: firebase deploy --only functions:setAdminRole,functions:banUser && npm run enable-callables
scripts.demo: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project script-automator-bdbef --import ../emulator-data --export-on-exit ../emulator-data
scripts.demo:check: firebase emulators:exec --project script-automator-bdbef --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "npm run demo:seed"
